c06ed6.conditions: none found; every wildcard receive is separated from the next same-tag phase by a synchronising collective chain
c06ed6.reasoning: With interp_type 4, MGRBuildInterpApproximateInverse calls MGRGetSubBlock twice (A_ff, A_fc), and each runs hypre_LocateAssumedPartition, which receives tag 17 with MPI_ANY_SOURCE (par_csr_assumed_part.c:259). No DataExchangeList follows these, so a cross-call mix-up would need a fast rank's next-call messages to arrive early. But each MGRGetSubBlock starts with BoomerAMGCoarseParms (MPI_Scan) and then MPI_Bcast from rank P-1. Rank P-1's Scan result needs every rank to have joined, and every other rank's Bcast needs P-1, so this works as a barrier. After A_fc's Locate, the only path to the next Locate goes through ParMatmul (A_ff already has its comm package) and then an MPI_Allreduce. Every other Locate is followed by DataExchangeList, whose tree termination also synchronises, and its tags change with rnum. Within one call, arrival order only changes the order of a list that is then sorted. Isends plus a posted response receive mean no dependence on buffering.
